body:
# **Ultimate Hardcore 1000 - Modpack Overview**

Welcome to the official documentation and introduction for the Ultimate Hardcore 1000 survival project! This comprehensive guide provides everything you need to know about the pack's core philosophy, installation requirements, active mod list, and technical building mechanics. Dive in and prepare for the ultimate solo survival experience.
## 📋 Project Concept & Overview

Ultimate Hardcore 1000 is a highly optimized, brutal, yet rewarding single-player experience locked into Minecraft version 1.20.4 (Forge). The primary goal is simple yet daunting: survive 1,000 in-game days while conquering an expanded ecosystem of hostile AI, massive procedural structures, and over 1,000 custom community achievements. Blazeandcave's advancements pack needs to be downloaded sepreatly at [here](https://modrinth.com/datapack/blazeandcaves-advancements-pack)

Note on Automation & Technical Farms: The farms & Automation stuff will not be included in the mod pack. (down below is the main thing you would need)

   [The Spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-jyAkbqP4yPU3eiGqpCnqWu2Qie1WVpXEcE-s6P3cEQ/edit?usp=sharing)

### Recommended Instance settings
    
Recommended RAM Allocation: 6GB to 8GB Maximum (Do not allocate 16GB+).

Launch Argument Rule: Ensure your profile uses -Xmx6G or -Xmx8G.

Modrinth Profile: Forge Loader for Minecraft 1.20.4.  

🛠️ Core Mod List & Structural Datapacks

Performance & Memory: Based on Fabulously Optimized, Memory Leak Fix   

Lethal Threats & Advencement to drive you crazy: SmartBrainLib (AI Upgrade), BlazeandCave’s Advancements, Day Counter   

Terrain & Dungeons: Terralith, Tectonic, When Dungeons Arise, The YUNG's series.

🏆 Technical Farm Resources & Credits (Worlds/Tutorials Are Included In Spereadsheet)
